name: before-compact
description: Keeps your last turns, verbatim, across compaction. A PreCompact hook saves the last turns verbatim (and the full arc beside them); a SessionStart hook re-injects them after compaction. /before-compact:recover does it on demand; /before-compact opens a monitor pane with the summary the engine installed.

summary_instructions.title: Extra instructions for the compaction summarizer
summary_instructions.description: Off when empty (default). When set, the mod's session.compact hook appends this text, on its own line, to the instructions the summarizer is given, after anything typed after /compact. How much the summarizer honours instructions is documented to exist, not measured; the pane's Summary tab (3) is where to look.

inject_in_mod.title: Experiment: re-inject from the mod instead of the SessionStart hook
inject_in_mod.description: Off (default): the SessionStart settings hook prints your last turns as text. On: the mod's session.compact hook appends your last user messages, as the engine's own messages, after the summary, and tells the script to stand down. Whether the engine keeps them in the next request is unverified; see the README.

inject_turns.title: Experiment: how many user turns the mod appends
inject_turns.description: Used only when inject_in_mod is on. 1 to 50.

inject_max_chars.title: Experiment: character budget for the appended turns
inject_max_chars.description: Used only when inject_in_mod is on. Newest turns are kept first; older ones are dropped once the budget is spent.
